description: Make a short video on this computer when someone asks for a clip or an animation.

offer.reason: offered only to an adult on their own written screen, when the household has video on and the Stack has a video model

author: MaiPai

examples: make a short video of a paper boat in the rain
can you generate a video of a dragon flying over a castle
make a clip of waves on a beach at sunset
turn that picture into a video
create a short animation of a robot waving hello

prompt.description: What the video shows, written as a full description in plain English: the subject, what moves, the setting and the light or mood, built from what the person asked for. For a picture that moves, describe the motion. Keep their own words for names. Do not add people, objects or themes they did not ask for.

from_picture.description: Optional. Set to "latest" only when the person asks to animate or bring to life a picture that was made earlier in this chat. Leave it out for a video from words alone. Pictures the person uploaded cannot be animated.

orientation.description: Optional shape of the video. landscape is the default. Use portrait only for a phone-style tall video when the person asks.

seconds.description: Optional length in seconds, 1 to 5. Leave it out for 5.

style.description: Optional. The name of one of the household's saved video styles, only when the person names it. Leave it out otherwise; never invent one.

depicts_real_person.description: Set true when the person asks for a video that shows a real, named or identifiable person (a celebrity, a politician, someone they know). Home does not make those. Otherwise leave it out.

config.label: Adults can make videos
config.help: Adults can ask chat for short videos. Children and teens cannot, whatever this says.

copy.does: Lets adults ask chat to make short videos on this computer. Children and teens never can.

config.label: Adult-only video styles
config.help: Whether adults can use video styles marked adult-only. Children and teens never can.

copy.does: Chooses whether adults can use video styles marked adult-only.

options.allowed: Adults can use every video style in the library.
options.restricted: Adults can use only video styles marked for all ages.
